body:
This adds two networks (Exploren and Wevolt) with no typical price yet, and maps ten unmatched operators to the networks whose apps they run through. No typical price changes.

| Change | Old → new | Source (exact wording) |
|---|---|---|
| Chargefox `match` + `yurika`, `queensland electric super highway` | — | Queensland TMR EV snapshot names Chargefox as the charge point operator for the QESH, and Yurika owns and operates the stations. Goondiwindi Regional Council (2023): drivers "download the Chargefox app" to use and pay. https://www.tmr.qld.gov.au/community-and-environment/electric-vehicles/electric-vehicle-snapshot · https://www.grc.qld.gov.au/News-and-Events/News/Council-News/2023/EV-Station-in-Goondiwindi-Boosts-the-Electric-Super-Highway |
| Chargefox `match` + `raa` | — | RAA: find an RAA Charge site, then "charge your EV and pay through the Chargefox app or with your RFID card". RAA calls Chargefox its "platform provider". https://www.raa.com.au/motor/motoring-services/ev-charging-stations |
| Chargefox `match` + `electric highway tasmania` | — | NRMA: "We own Electric Highway Tasmania". PlugShare listings and AEVA say EHT sites are paid with the Chargefox app or card, or a credit card. https://www.aeva.asn.au/files/364/ |
| Chargefox `match` + `wa ev network`, `horizon power` | — | Horizon Power (WA EV Network): "You'll be able to pay via the Chargefox app or credit card". Its fees list DC at 0.60/kWh (seen through search; the page returns 403 to the fetch tool). https://www.horizonpower.com.au/utilities/pricing/ |
| Chargefox `match` + `woolworths` | — | Woolworths' Queensland charger sites, including Dakabin, "are all available on the Chargefox App". This comes from the Chargefox × Everyday Rewards release. https://www.propertycenterpiece.com.au/post/chargefox-partners-with-woolworths-everyday-rewards-points |
| Evie `match` + `charging the regions` | — | CVGA: "Evie Networks contracted for operation and maintenance of the installed chargers" (23 fast sites). https://www.cvga.org.au/charging-the-regions.html |
| **New network `exploren`**, match `exploren`, `engie` | — | Typical price `null`, basis `none`. ZECAR gives only a DC range ($0.55–0.75), and costtocharge.com.au lists 4 sites at $0.35–0.70, so no source gives a typical figure. `siteReading` `forbidden`, because the workflow says Exploren's terms forbid automated reading. Engie: The Glen says its ENGIE chargers were "upgraded to include the Exploren software platform", and Chargefox still works at the DC chargers. https://zecar.com/resources/what-ev-charging-providers-are-in-australia · https://www.theglen.com.au/centre-info/parking |
| **New network `wevolt`**, match `wevolt`, `electrona` | — | Typical price `null`, basis `none`. Wevolt: chargers are "owned and run by independent operators" who "set their own prices", and payment is "handled in the app". Electrona (Tasmania) takes cards at the charger, with Wevolt as the app alternative; Bicheno is DC $3/session + $0.64/kWh. https://wevolt.com.au/drivers · https://electrona.au/ |

`updated` changes from 2026-11-15 to 2026-11-18. `format.mjs` and `validate.mjs --base-ref origin/main` both pass.

**Unsure about**
- **`raa` and `woolworths` matching too much:** these match by substring. `raa` is short and could catch an unrelated name containing "raa". A site at a Woolworths that another network runs could also be read as Chargefox if Chargefox is checked first.
- **Engie:** its sites work with both Exploren and Chargefox. I chose Exploren because the Exploren operator already covers Engie-named sites, such as "Scorseby Engie".
- **Wevolt `siteReading`:** left as `unchecked`. robots.txt allows user-requested AI fetches, but the website terms say not to access the site "in any way other than through the interface we provide".
- **Ampol at 75c:** a comparison blog (gridly.com.au, which wouldn't load) and OzBargain users say Ampol's standard price is now 75c/kWh. There's no official or news source, so the 0.69 stays. Worth a look in the Ampol app.
- **Pages that wouldn't load:** mynrma.com.au and horizonpower.com.au return 403 to the fetch tool. The Evie FAQ gives no per-kWh figures.
- **The Driven feed:** it wasn't in the sources folder this run, so I opened no The Driven articles.
- **Price checks:** every network was checked on 2026-10-27, so none is over six months and no price-check issue was opened.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
title: [prices] Add Exploren and Wevolt; map Yurika/QESH, RAA, EHT, WA EV Network, Woolworths, Charging the Regions, Engie, Electrona

message: Done: one PR opened covering all 12 operators. Memory updated. No price changed, and no network's price check is over six months old, so no issue was needed.
